title: Beams and Glowing Eyes
dateBasis: UTC, from the archived creation timestamp
method: Every work in the room was inspected directly from the published WebP at 640 px in room order and as one wall before writing. Numbers come from data/gallery.json or data/abstract.json. No model inference calls were made; the text was written by the assistant in the session.
scope: The owned subset: the 21 works the locked structure places in this room, in room order.
introduction: In this room the eyes are lamps. Twenty-one works from May 2022 share one device: a head or a creature whose eyes give off light, and a beam that crosses the square like a searchlight. Where the light lands, the drawing goes pale and the lines show through it. Where it does not, the ground stays dense, scribbled in olive, red and blue.

The light takes two forms. In the framed heads it is a hard wedge, drawn as a solid band of pale yellow laid over everything, with a bright white disc where it starts. In the painted creatures, the bears and the hooded figure, it is a halo, soft at the edges, with round spots of glare floating in it like dust in a projector.

Twelve of the works came in five days, May 7 to 11. The rest arrived in a second run ten days later. Watch what the beam does to the thing it comes from: it fixes where you look, and it turns the rest of the head into shadow.

chapters.title: Five Days in May
chapters.opening: Six framed heads open the room, drawn between May 7 and 9. Each one is packed to the frame with marks, and each one is cut by a beam.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #73
works.text: A head tips to the right inside a tan frame, two square eyes glowing white, and a beam spills out of them toward the lower right corner. The mouth is a panel of upright teeth, lit from the same source. Around the head the ground is a weave of olive, yellow and blue scribble, with orange fence posts along the bottom. The light is drawn as a pale band laid over all of it, so the scribble shows through the beam like a pattern through gauze.
works.caption: A tilted head in a tan frame, two square eyes glowing white, a beam spilling to the lower right.
works.reading: The beam is one broad stroke of pale yellow with soft edges, and everything beneath it is still visible, only lightened. The eyes are two rounded squares with a white disc in each, the brightest points in the picture. A loop of black and white line marks the jaw, and the fence posts at the bottom are the only solid color. Recorded with 531 strokes.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #74
works.text: Turned on its side, a machine of a head: a bar of four round dials, a stack of triangles, a grid for a cheek, and beams crossing the whole thing on the diagonal.
works.caption: A machine-like head on its side, four round dials in a row, beams crossing on the diagonal.
works.reading: Nothing here sits upright. The dials, the triangles and the grid all lean at the same angle, and the two beams run against that lean, so the picture is built on crossed diagonals. The palette is the palest in the room, mostly cream and olive with one yellow triangle and a red spiral in the corner.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #75
works.text: One huge round eye on the left throws a wide beam down and to the right, past a small square eye and a grinning row of teeth.
works.caption: A dark head with one huge round eye casting a wide beam down and right, a grin below.
works.reading: The two eyes do not match. The left one is a big ring with a glowing center, the right a small lit square, and the beam comes only from the big one. Under them a row of teeth is lit like a shelf. The ground is a pattern of small ringed shapes in red, blue and olive, dense enough to make the beam the only open space.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #76 cash lightning
works.text: The same head again, under green light. The drawing is the one from #75 with the colors shifted: the beam is lime, the eye has a spiral in it, and the whole ground has gone cool. Its title is the only one in the room with words, cash lightning. Set the two side by side and the difference is the light alone, warm on one and acid on the other, falling on identical lines.
works.caption: A dark head with one huge spiral eye throwing a lime green beam down and to the right.
works.reading: Under the green the ringed shapes of the ground turn from red to teal, and a scatter of pale discs floats in the lower right, where the beam lands. The spiral inside the big eye is the one new mark. Recorded with 512 strokes, 88 more than the warm version, most of them in the light.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #77
works.caption: Two square glowing eyes above a long lit bar of teeth, in a frame of olive and orange.
works.reading: The teeth are the brightest thing here, a horizontal bar lit from inside like a sign, with the two square eyes above it giving off their own glow. The ground is a tangle of orange, green and black line with a row of hanging drips on the right. Three sources of light, and none of them a beam.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #78
works.text: Under a glass dome on a round base, a small creature with two glowing eyes sits in a flood of yellow rays, the whole picture lit from behind it.
works.caption: A small creature with glowing eyes sits under a glass dome on a round base, bathed in yellow rays.
works.reading: The dome is drawn as a soft oval of pale strokes, and the creature inside is small, blue-grey and roughly sketched, with two bright dots for eyes and a round mouth. Rays fan out from behind the dome across the whole square, and round spots of glare drift in them. This is the softest drawing of the first week.

chapters.title: Bears and Helmets
chapters.opening: Two days, May 9 to 11, and six works. A furry creature appears twice, once with its eyes lit and once in the dark, and then the heads put on helmets.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #79
works.text: A round, furry creature with two enormous glowing eyes squats on a patch of grass, orange stripes behind its head, its paws folded over its belly.
works.caption: A furry dark creature with two enormous glowing eyes squats on grass, paws folded over its belly.
works.reading: The fur is drawn in short dark hatching with yellow and blue showing through, and the eyes are two discs of light with rings inside them, so bright that the fur around them goes gold. Pink and orange scribble fills the top corners, and the grass at the bottom is drawn in small green and pink dabs.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #80
works.text: The same creature, half an hour later, with the lights off. It sits in plain black now, inside a white border, and its eyes are two dark spirals where the lamps were. The fur is the same hatching, the paws are the same, the belly has the same pale patch. Without the glow the creature looks smaller and more worried, and the drawing is mostly shadow.
works.caption: A furry dark creature sits in black, inside a white border, its eyes two dark spirals.
works.reading: With no light source the colors inside the fur come forward: purple, blue and gold hatching that the glow had washed out. The spirals of the eyes are drawn in thin black line on dark grey. The white border is the only bright thing in the picture. Recorded 32 minutes after the lit version.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #82
works.text: In profile, facing left, a head sends two beams out of two square eyes, while a black band on the right edge holds the picture like a shoulder.
works.caption: A head in profile facing left, two beams from two square eyes, a black band at the right edge.
works.reading: The beams are two wedges that overlap as they leave the eyes, and the lower one lights up a row of zigzag lines like writing on a page. The rest of the head is scribble in red, lilac and blue over dark grey. The black band at the right is drawn with a rounded corner, a shape more like a chair back than a shoulder.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #83
works.text: A creature with a yellow beak and a row of hanging teeth like icicles, its eyes two glowing leaf shapes, set in a frame of pale blue.
works.caption: A creature with a yellow beak and teeth hanging like icicles, two glowing leaf-shaped eyes, in pale blue.
works.reading: The teeth are drawn as long triangles with yellow drips at their points, hung from a red bar. The beak and the two eyes are the same leaf shape at three sizes. Around them the ground is grey and white scribble in tight loops, with the blue frame picking up the blue in the lines.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #84
works.text: A blue head with a crest like a helmet, a wide grin of white teeth, and a single beam from a square eye at the upper left.
works.caption: A blue head wearing a helmet-like crest, a wide white grin, one beam from an eye at upper left.
works.reading: The crest is a stack of gold shapes with white lettering scratched into it, and the beam comes from behind it. The grin runs the full width of the lower head, drawn as a row of white blocks with pink above them. The ground is lilac and blue scribble, with two small spirals floating in the beam.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #85
works.text: Painted, not scribbled: a helmeted figure in gold and black holds its hands together under a grinning mouth, lit by a wide beam from the upper left.
works.caption: A helmeted figure in gold and black clasps its hands under a grinning mouth, lit from the upper left.
works.reading: The surface is laid down in broad painted strokes with stitched lines across them, and the helmet is a box of crumpled color on top of the head. The eyes are two small gold points. The beam is a soft diagonal of yellow over black, and the figure's hands, held like a prayer, are the most carefully drawn part. Recorded with 699 strokes.

chapters.title: Eyes Like Lamps
chapters.opening: After nine days away the glow comes back bigger. From May 20 to 22 the eyes become whole lamps, and two of the creatures start to speak.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #86
works.text: A head with a mop of wild yellow and black hair, a thin neck, and two orbs of light for eyes, each one larger than the mouth beneath it.
works.caption: A head with wild yellow and black hair, a thin neck, two orbs of light for eyes.
works.reading: The hair is drawn in long crossing strokes of yellow, black and red, and it sits on the head like a nest. Below it the face is almost nothing but the two lamps, drawn as rings of light with a bright center and a glow that spreads over the cheeks. The neck and shoulders are sketched in a few lines and left dark.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #90
works.text: A teddy bear with sparking antennae sits in a burst of orange rays, its eyes two small lamps and the word BULLISH written across its chest.
works.caption: A teddy bear with sparking antennae sits in orange rays, BULLISH written across its chest.
works.reading: The bear is drawn in soft gold strokes over the orange, with a red outline that vibrates around its edges. The antennae are two black stalks with white sparks at the tips. Its shadow stretches down and to the left as if the light came from above and behind it.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #93
works.text: A head in white scribble over pink and orange, two beams driving to the right out of the eyes, three orange drips hanging from the top.
works.caption: A head in white scribble over pink and orange, two beams to the right, orange drips from the top.
works.reading: The beams are the loudest in the room, two bright wedges that fill the right half of the square. Under them the mouth is a red panel of teeth, and a small black eye with a lid sits at the left. The three drips at the top are thick and opaque, the only marks that are not line or light.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #94
works.caption: A tower-like head with two glowing square eyes beaming right, over dense black and white scribble.
works.reading: The head is a narrow column with two lit squares near the top, and the beams run right from them across blue stripes. The rest of the square is black and white scribble so dense it becomes texture, with purple and yellow breaking through at the left.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #95
works.text: An armored figure in black and gold, with a visor and one red eye, points a finger under a sky of blue rays.
works.caption: An armored figure in black and gold with a visor and one red eye points a finger under blue rays.
works.reading: The armor is drawn in black strokes with gold and white highlights, and the shoulders spread wide like wings. The visor is a yellow curve with a single red eye behind it. The blue rays come from behind the figure, so the light here is a backdrop and not a beam.

chapters.title: Two More Bears and a Skull
chapters.opening: The room closes with the largest drawings in it: a hooded figure holding lights, a bear with glowing goggles, a wolf with a slogan, and a skull mask lit from inside.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #97
works.text: Inside a dark frame a hooded, bearded figure with glowing eyes holds out a hand, and round spots of light float around it like bubbles.
works.caption: A hooded bearded figure with glowing eyes holds out a hand, round spots of light floating around it.
works.reading: The beard and hood are drawn in dense gold hatching, and the eyes are two small lamps that light the face from inside. Wide beams cross the square from the upper left, and the floating discs sit at different sizes, as if at different distances. The figure holds a small sphere of light in its raised hand.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #99
works.text: A bear sits on a white ground, painted in soft grey and gold, its eyes hidden behind red goggles that glow. Two beams leave the goggles toward the lower left. On its shoulder, almost too small to see, stands a tiny figure. The bear is drawn with long, careful painted strokes, its paws resting on its knees, and the white around it is cloudy, not flat. With 817 recorded strokes it is the most worked drawing in the room.
works.caption: A painted bear on white, red goggles glowing, beams to the lower left, a tiny figure on its shoulder.
works.reading: The goggles are two red lenses joined by a bridge, and the glow spreads from them over the bear's muzzle. The tiny figure on the shoulder has its own dot of red. At the lower left a dark paw sits in a pool of shadow, the one solid dark in a picture that is otherwise mist.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #100
works.text: A wolf-like creature with tall ears and glowing eyes bares its teeth in the dark, beside the words STILL BULLISH in orange.
works.caption: A wolf-like creature with tall ears and glowing eyes bares its teeth beside the words STILL BULLISH.
works.reading: The creature is drawn in short gold and orange strokes over black, and the glow from its eyes lights the inside of its ears and the fur of its chest. The lettering is drawn like a sticker, orange with a white outline, and sits at the left edge at the height of the jaw.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #113
works.text: A skull mask fills a brown frame, its two eyes glowing yellow like headlamps, a beam falling from them to the lower right. Blue tubes rise from the top of the head, a crown of red zigzag runs under the cheekbone, and a necklace of white beads hangs across the jaw. The ground is a curtain of brown scribble. It is the last of the framed heads, and the one where the eyes and the beam are the same yellow as the paint.
works.caption: A skull mask in a brown frame, eyes glowing yellow like headlamps, a beam falling to the lower right.
works.reading: The eyes are two heavy rings with bright centers, drawn in yellow and orange over the skull, and the beam below them is the same yellow at lower strength. Teeth are drawn as a row of small squares under a red zigzag. The blue tubes at the top are the only cool color, and they are solid where everything else is line.

closing: Go back to the bear with its lights on, and then to the bear with its lights off. Everything in the drawing is the same except the eyes, and the whole mood of the creature changes with them. That is what the room is about: a drawn light that decides where you look, and what you can see of the rest.
